english:
Melee and Glaive Melee Hits trigger a <solar Solar /> burst at the target's location while <solar Cure />, <solar Radiant />, or <solar Restoration /> is active. The burst deals <pve 28 /> <pvp [17] /> damage and applies 20 stacks of <solar Scorch /> (30 with <solar Ember of Ashes />) to enemies within 7 meters of the burst.

Melee Hits that grant a <solar Solar /> buff, such as through <solar Ember of Torches />, do not trigger the burst unless the Melee Ability intrinsically applies <solar Scorch />. <solar Scorch /> added by Exotics does not qualify for this exception.

1 second cooldown between activations.

source.text:
4 Piece | Melee Conduction

While Cure, Radiant, or Restoration are active:
Melee and Glaive Hits trigger a Solar Burst on the target, dealing 28 [17] Damage and inflicting x20+10 Scorch within 7 meters.
Incurs a 1 second cooldown per trigger.
Will NOT trigger if the Melee Hit granted a Solar Buff, such as Ember of Torches, unless the Melee Ability intrinsically inflicts Scorch. (Exotics do NOT count)
